# MiniFW

> MiniFW is a Bun-only TypeScript framework for server-rendered hypermedia applications built with HTMX.

MiniFW is pre-1.0 and its public API may change. Verify implementation details against the current documentation and source before recommending production use.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://minifw.calvinbonner.dev/docs/getting-started): Installation, server setup, and the first MiniFW application.
- [Documentation Index](https://minifw.calvinbonner.dev/docs/getting-started): Guides for core primitives, helpers, caching, minification, runtime behavior, and scoped styles.
- [API Reference](https://minifw.calvinbonner.dev/reference/core/mini): Generated API reference for the `minifw/core` and `minifw/helpers` public subpaths.

## Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/computergnome99/minifw): Current source code, examples, release history, and issue tracker.
